# Spec Quality Checklist: Sistema de Inventário e WMS (Padaria)

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, and clarity of the requirements in the feature specification.
**Created**: 2026-08-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](file:///d:/dev/padaria-inventario-react/specs/001-inventario-padaria/spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command to ensure the requirements are ready for implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the dynamic fields for turn settings (nome, ordem, horario_inicio, horario_fim, notificacao_tipo) completely specified? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements > 2]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the specific fields for the `recebimentos_itens` table defined for both order-linked and manual entries? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the conditions that trigger the daily final email summary clearly documented? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements > 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is the fuzzy matching algorithm's similarity threshold quantified or parameterized? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements > 1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the "Operação Offline" threshold or cache eviction policy clearly defined? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements > 2]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the boundary values for the `limite_global_fiado` check specified (e.g. including or excluding the exact limit value)? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements > 4]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the soft-delete rules in the entities (ativo = 'NÃO') align consistently with the historical FK lookups in `lancamentos_op`? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the role distinction between gestores (OAuth) and operators (PIN) enforced consistently across all RPC functions? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements > 2 & §Requirements > 4]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK009 Does the spec define how the system handles speech recognition failures or transcription timeouts? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behavior for resolving concurrent sync conflicts on the same sector/shift explicitly documented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the fallback pathways specified when the Google OAuth API is unavailable? [Edge Case, Gap]
